name: SVDAG with 2b Header Tags
aliases: SVDAG Parameter Optimization: Multi-type Pointers with 2b Header Tags
definition: An optimization where the Child Node Mask (CHNM) Header Tags (HT) are 2 bits long instead of 1 bit. This allows four distinct codes (00, 01, 10, 11) to distinguish between passive suboctants and three different types of active child node pointers (PT1, PT2, PT3), enabling compression by using shorter pointers for closer nodes.
summary: SVDAG with 2b Header Tags is a compression optimization for Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graphs that uses 2-bit tags to enable variable-length pointers, trading compactness for reduced memory footprint.
